answer: Parallel Vine Sampling.** Each identity must periodically solve independent micro-tasks drawn from a shared vine of verified work, and solutions are cross-checked by a random sparrow subset of peers. Identities whose answers diverge from the consensus cluster are quarantined and their task rewards routed to reviewers. Attacker cost: every fake identity must sustain real compute on fresh tasks and survive peer cross-checks, so marginal cost per sybil scales with quartz-grade verification labor rather than a one-time fee.
